cohort: The study included 91 neonates with a mean gestational age of 34.2 (3.8) weeks and a mean postnatal age of 38.3 (35.4) days, categorized into Early, Medium, and Late groups based on postnatal age quartiles (days 10 and 56).
finding: The influence of postconceptional age, oral feeding, and anaerobic metabolism on salivary cortisol levels was observed during the birth transition period but diminished or was not present beyond 10 days of life.
